summary: Routing migration in routers/router.go is blocked because prerequisite migrations for server construction, middleware, and handler function signatures have not been applied.
manual_review_notes: Route registration requires Hertz server instance (*server.Hertz) and Hertz handler signatures (app.HandlerFunc).
Handlers in package api and v1 currently use *gin.Context.
Middleware functions (jwt.JWT, gin.Logger, gin.Recovery) currently use Gin types.
